title: Applying a build-tab saved view restores builder state (onMounted path)
verifies: a view saved on the Build tab (line chart + X-axis field) restores that exact state when applied from the Logs tab

title: Applying a saved view while already on the Build tab re-initializes the builder (watcher path)
verifies: applying different views while the Build tab is already mounted swaps the builder to each view's chart type in place (no remount)

title: Custom-query saved view restores to Custom mode + table chart
verifies: a view saved in Custom query mode restores to Custom mode with a table chart rather than a re-parsed builder query

title: View saved without buildData (Logs-tab save) applies without breaking Build tab
verifies: a view saved from the Logs tab (no buildData) applies cleanly and the Build tab re-derives defaults without error

title: One-shot semantics: toggling away and back re-derives instead of re-restoring
verifies: savedBuildConfig is consumed once; a Logs→Build round-trip after apply re-derives the chart type instead of re-applying the saved view
